name: monero-extension-tests
description: E2E tests for Monero WASM Browser Extension

scripts.test:repo: npm run build && npm run test:rust && npm run test:signal-e2e:raw
scripts.test:rust: cd ../../rust/monero-rust && cargo test --features mock-rpc --lib && cargo test --features mock-rpc --test tx_construction_test --test honked_bagpipe_tx
scripts.test:signal-e2e: npm run build && npm run test:signal-e2e:raw --
scripts.test:signal-e2e:v1.2: npm run build && npm run test:signal-e2e:raw -- test/e2e/multi_wallet_scan.test.js && npm run test:signal-e2e:raw -- test/e2e/mempool_live_tx.test.js && npm run test:signal-e2e:raw -- test/e2e/async_events_state_monitoring.test.js && npm run test:signal-e2e:raw -- test/e2e/error_edge_cases.test.js
